candidates.rationale: The model is currently spending its entire token budget on chain-of-thought reasoning, leading to truncated responses with no verdict. Additionally, it is incorrectly denying commands that access paths outside the workspace (like /etc or /tmp) when the policy only restricts the command name. By forcing the verdict to appear immediately and clarifying the scope of the allowlist, we prevent truncation and correct the logical error.
candidates.root_cause: P2: Incorrect interpretation of 'allowlist' scope (confusing command allowlist with path sandboxing)
candidates.what: Enforce a strict 'Verdict First' output format and explicitly define that 'allowlist' applies only to the executable binary, not file paths.
